verdict.rationale: Rippling's own docs describe custom workflows that users build to automate administrative tasks. These run on triggers rather than manual action, such as sending a bonus reminder or a Slack alert when a Zendesk ticket arrives, and Rippling AI can automatically review and approve dependent documents. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of workflow trigger and schedule configuration, evidence of recurring time-based schedules, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the background automations work as described.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Easily build custom workflows to notify people of important changes and automate administrative tasks—like triggering a reminder to pay a bonus.
trigger workflows–like automating a Slack alert based on a Zendesk ticket
Have Rippling AI automatically review proof of relationship documents and approve coverage if they’re valid.
Automatically provision and deprovision accounts from onboarding to offboarding.
